description: Route personal and work intentions to the right connected system of record without making the user choose an app.

defaultPrompt: Remind me to deal with this next Monday.
Save the decision we just made so we can find it later.
Research this now and turn the result into the next action.
interface.longDescription: Turns natural-language intentions into the appropriate action across connected tools. It separates things to know, things to do, scheduled events, conditions to watch, team work items, email operations, and files; avoids duplicate state; and retrieves prior state from the most likely source automatically.

name: personal-control-plane
